claude.basis: The Claude Code release CI's plugin-mattstack-mods job installs and the live-18/live-19 runs used. Each version is listed on its own: a version inside the mods' TESTED_CLAUDE_CODE range is not tested until it is added here.

codex.basis: The Codex release the app-server protocol fixture (CODEX_PROTOCOL_VERSION) was captured from. A later release is not tested until it is added here.
